name: Step 4: technician arrived -> installed
description: Technician arrived → installed.
query:
-- Funnel step 4: technician arrived to installed
-- B2I L1. Cohort = bookings whose booking fee was paid in the window, on the real
-- calendar (D-1 = yesterday), so labels mean what they say and line up with L0.
-- Stages are measured over a 14-day horizon from each booking's own fee timestamp.
-- Columns 11-19 return a maturity label per window: 'matured' means the window has
-- closed and the number is final; otherwise '<date>|<days>' -- the date the newest
-- booking in the window finishes its 14 days, after which the value cannot change.
-- Columns 20-28 return the raw 'numerator/denominator' behind each percentage.
-- booking_confirmed is deliberately NOT a stage: it is the same event as
-- booking_verified and is absent for ~36% of fee-paying bookings, so it under-reports.
-- Bookings still open at the end of the horizon stay in the denominator.
WITH b AS (SELECT DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
per AS (
  SELECT 'D-1' lbl, 1 ord, today-1 f, today-1 t FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-2',2, today-2, today-2 FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-3',3, today-3, today-3 FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-1',4, DATEADD('day',-7,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)),  DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-2',5, DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-8,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-3',6, DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)) FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-1',7, DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)) FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-2',8, DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-3',9, DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM b
),
mrt AS (
  -- the window closes once its NEWEST booking day has had its full 14 days, i.e.
  -- 14+1 days after p.t, since a booking late on day p.t needs 14 days from then
  SELECT p.lbl, p.ord, b.today,
    DATEADD('day', 14 + 1, p.t) AS close_date
  FROM per p CROSS JOIN b
),
f0 AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, PARSE_JSON(DATA):transaction_id::STRING AS TXN, MIN(ADDED_TIME) AS t
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME='booking_fee_captured' AND MOBILE>'5999999999'
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD('day',-190,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
f1 AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, t,
    CASE WHEN LAG(t) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY t) IS NULL
          OR DATEDIFF('second', LAG(t) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY t), t) > 3600
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_sess
  FROM f0
),
f2 AS (SELECT MOBILE, t, SUM(new_sess) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY t ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS sess FROM f1),
fee AS (SELECT MOBILE, sess, MIN(t) AS FEE_T FROM f2 GROUP BY 1,2),
cyc AS (SELECT MOBILE, FEE_T, LEAD(FEE_T) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY FEE_T) AS NEXT_FEE_T FROM fee),
cohort AS (
  SELECT c.MOBILE, c.FEE_T, c.NEXT_FEE_T, p.lbl, p.ord
  FROM cyc c
  JOIN per p ON DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,c.FEE_T)) BETWEEN p.f AND p.t
),
ev AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, EVENT_NAME, ADDED_TIME
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE MOBILE>'5999999999'
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD('day',-190,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    AND EVENT_NAME IN ('address_updated','rohit_assigned','rohit_arrived','installed')
),
hit AS (
  SELECT c.lbl, c.ord, c.MOBILE, c.FEE_T,
    MAX(IFF(e.EVENT_NAME='address_updated',1,0)) AS addr,
    MAX(IFF(e.EVENT_NAME='rohit_assigned',1,0))  AS assigned,
    MAX(IFF(e.EVENT_NAME='rohit_arrived',1,0))   AS arrived,
    MAX(IFF(e.EVENT_NAME='installed',1,0))       AS installed14,
    MAX(IFF(e.EVENT_NAME='installed' AND e.ADDED_TIME < DATEADD('day',7,c.FEE_T),1,0)) AS installed7
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN ev e
    ON e.MOBILE = c.MOBILE
   AND e.ADDED_TIME >= c.FEE_T
   AND e.ADDED_TIME <  DATEADD('day',14,c.FEE_T)
   AND (c.NEXT_FEE_T IS NULL OR e.ADDED_TIME < c.NEXT_FEE_T)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
agg AS (
  SELECT lbl,
    COUNT(*) AS bfp,
    SUM(addr) AS addr, SUM(assigned) AS assigned, SUM(arrived) AS arrived,
    SUM(installed14) AS installed14, SUM(installed7) AS installed7
  FROM hit GROUP BY lbl
),
fin AS (
  -- LEFT JOIN off the window list, not the data, so a window with no bookings
  -- still returns its maturity label instead of vanishing
  SELECT m.lbl, m.ord,
    CASE WHEN m.today >= m.close_date THEN 'matured'
         ELSE TO_CHAR(m.close_date, 'DD Mon') || '|'
              || DATEDIFF('day', m.today, m.close_date)::STRING END AS matlbl,
    a.bfp, a.addr, a.assigned, a.arrived, a.installed14, a.installed7
  FROM mrt m LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.lbl = m.lbl
)
SELECT 'Step 4: technician arrived -> installed' AS kpi,
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-1' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "D-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-2' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "D-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-3' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "D-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-1' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "W-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-2' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "W-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-3' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "W-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-1' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "M-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-2' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "M-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-3' THEN ROUND(100.0*installed14/NULLIF(arrived,0),1) END) AS "M-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-1' THEN matlbl END) AS "D-1 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-2' THEN matlbl END) AS "D-2 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-3' THEN matlbl END) AS "D-3 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-1' THEN matlbl END) AS "W-1 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-2' THEN matlbl END) AS "W-2 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-3' THEN matlbl END) AS "W-3 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-1' THEN matlbl END) AS "M-1 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-2' THEN matlbl END) AS "M-2 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-3' THEN matlbl END) AS "M-3 maturity",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-1' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "D-1 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-2' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "D-2 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-3' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "D-3 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-1' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "W-1 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-2' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "W-2 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-3' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "W-3 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-1' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "M-1 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-2' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "M-2 counts",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-3' THEN IFF(arrived IS NULL, NULL, installed14::STRING || '/' || arrived::STRING) END) AS "M-3 counts"
FROM fin

name: Renewal payment funnel (app journey)
description: Of plan expiries, how far the customer got in the app renewal journey: opened the app, reached the plans page, completed payment. Each stage is measured from 3 days before expiry to 7 days after, so an early renewal is credited with the visit that produced it. This covers payments made in the app only — a substantial share of renewals happen through other channels, so payment success here sits below the overall renewal rate.
note: A value marked * sits in a window whose observation period has not fully passed, so it will still rise — hover it for how much is in. A dash means app telemetry does not cover that window.
query:
-- Renewal payment funnel as a display grid: expiry -> app open -> plans page -> payment.
-- Expiries come from TRUM directly (same base and dedupe as the renewal curve), not from
-- DBT.FCT_EXPIRY_EVENTS, because that model only admits expiries old enough for its R15
-- flag and therefore runs 15 days behind -- it cannot populate D-1.
-- Observation window: 3 days before expiry to 7 days after, so a customer who renewed early
-- is credited with the plans-page visit that produced it instead of looking inactive.
-- A window is blanked entirely if app-open / checkout telemetry does not cover it, so a
-- half-covered month cannot masquerade as a collapse in conversion.
-- Cell encoding: "value~num/den", plus a trailing * and tooltip while the window is partial.
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
src_span AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(
    (SELECT MIN(LAUNCH_DATE)    FROM PROD_DB.DBT_CUSTOMER_POD.FCT_CUSTOMER_APP_OPENS),
    (SELECT MIN(PLAN_PAGE_DATE) FROM PROD_DB.DBT_CUSTOMER_POD.FCT_PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_DAILY)
  ) AS data_from
),
per AS (
  SELECT 'D-1' lbl, 1 ord, today-1 f, today-1 t FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-2',2, today-2, today-2 FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-3',3, today-3, today-3 FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-1',4, DATEADD('day',-7,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)),  DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-2',5, DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-8,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-3',6, DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-1',7, DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-2',8, DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-3',9, DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM params
),
raw AS (
  SELECT router_nas_id AS lng_nas_id, mobile,
    DATEADD(minute,330,otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz AS plan_start_time,
    DATEADD(minute,330,otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz AS plan_expiry_time,
    DATEADD(minute,330,created_on)::timestamp_ntz      AS recharge_time
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE auth_state = 1
    AND otp NOT IN ('FREE','PAY_ONLINE','CASH','ROAM')
    AND mobile <> '' AND mobile > '5999999999'
    AND store_group_id = 0 AND device_limit >= 10
    AND router_nas_id IS NOT NULL
    AND otp_expiry_time >= DATEADD(day,-140,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lng_nas_id, DATE(plan_expiry_time)
                                   ORDER BY recharge_time DESC) AS row_cnt
    FROM raw r
  ) WHERE row_cnt = 1
),
exp AS (SELECT lng_nas_id, mobile, DATE(plan_expiry_time) AS expiry_dt FROM dedup),
opens AS (SELECT DISTINCT MOBILE, LAUNCH_DATE AS d FROM PROD_DB.DBT_CUSTOMER_POD.FCT_CUSTOMER_APP_OPENS),
chk AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, PLAN_PAGE_DATE AS d, MAX(PAYMENT_SUCCESS) AS paid
  FROM PROD_DB.DBT_CUSTOMER_POD.FCT_PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_DAILY GROUP BY 1,2
),
flags AS (
  SELECT e.expiry_dt,
    MAX(IFF(o.MOBILE IS NOT NULL,1,0)) AS app_open,
    MAX(IFF(c.MOBILE IS NOT NULL,1,0)) AS plans_page,
    MAX(IFF(c.paid = 1,1,0))           AS pay_success
  FROM exp e
  LEFT JOIN opens o ON o.MOBILE = e.mobile
    AND o.d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-3,e.expiry_dt) AND DATEADD('day',7,e.expiry_dt)
  LEFT JOIN chk c ON c.MOBILE = e.mobile
    AND c.d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-3,e.expiry_dt) AND DATEADD('day',7,e.expiry_dt)
  GROUP BY e.expiry_dt, e.lng_nas_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT p.lbl, p.ord,
    COUNT(*)                     AS expiries,
    COUNT_IF(f.app_open=1)       AS n_open,
    COUNT_IF(f.plans_page=1)     AS n_plans,
    COUNT_IF(f.pay_success=1)    AS n_pay,
    (DATEADD('day',-3,p.f) >= (SELECT data_from FROM src_span))       AS measurable,
    (DATEADD('day',7,p.t) <= (SELECT today FROM params))              AS complete,
    ROUND(100.0*AVG(LEAST(11, GREATEST(0,
      DATEDIFF('day', DATEADD('day',-3,f.expiry_dt), (SELECT today FROM params)) + 1)))/11.0, 0)
                                                                      AS pct_elapsed
  FROM flags f JOIN per p ON f.expiry_dt BETWEEN p.f AND p.t
  GROUP BY p.lbl, p.ord, DATEADD('day',-3,p.f), DATEADD('day',7,p.t)
),
long AS (
  SELECT 1 rord, 'Expiries (base)'                 rlabel, lbl, ord, NULL::NUMBER num, expiries den, TRUE  base_row, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Opened the app',            lbl, ord, n_open,  expiries, FALSE, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Reached the plans page',    lbl, ord, n_plans, expiries, FALSE, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Payment success',           lbl, ord, n_pay,   expiries, FALSE, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'step: app open to plans',   lbl, ord, n_plans, n_open,   FALSE, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'step: plans to payment',    lbl, ord, n_pay,   n_plans,  FALSE, measurable, complete, pct_elapsed FROM stats
),
cells AS (
  SELECT rord, rlabel, lbl, ord,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT measurable THEN NULL
      WHEN base_row THEN TRIM(TO_CHAR(den,'FM999,999,999'))
      WHEN den = 0 OR den IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(100.0*num/den,1),'FM9990.0')) || '%'
           || IFF(complete,'','*')
           || '~' || TRIM(TO_CHAR(num,'FM999,999,999')) || '/' || TRIM(TO_CHAR(den,'FM999,999,999'))
           || IFF(complete,'','|Partial: about ' || TRIM(TO_CHAR(pct_elapsed,'FM990'))
                  || '% of the observation window (3 days before expiry to 7 days after) has'
                  || ' passed for this cohort, so this figure will still rise.')
    END AS cell
  FROM long
)
SELECT rlabel AS "Stage",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-1' THEN cell END) AS "D-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-2' THEN cell END) AS "D-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-3' THEN cell END) AS "D-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-1' THEN cell END) AS "W-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-2' THEN cell END) AS "W-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-3' THEN cell END) AS "W-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-1' THEN cell END) AS "M-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-2' THEN cell END) AS "M-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-3' THEN cell END) AS "M-3"
FROM cells GROUP BY rord, rlabel ORDER BY rord;

name: Renewal curve (R0 - R15)
description: Of plan expiries, the share whose next plan had started by day N after expiry. R0 means on or before the expiry moment itself. Each R counts only expiries that have actually had N days, so a figure appears only once it can be measured.
note: A value marked * covers only the earlier part of that window, because expiries later in it have not yet had N days — hover it for how much is included. A dash means no expiry in that window has had N days yet.
query:
-- Renewal curve R0..R15 as a display grid: one row per R, one column per window.
-- Definition is the supplied one, unchanged: TRUM with auth_state=1, otp not in
-- FREE/PAY_ONLINE/CASH/ROAM, store_group_id=0, device_limit>=10, real mobile; deduped to
-- one plan per (NAS, expiry date) keeping the latest recharge; next plan found by LEAD on
-- plan start; RN = share of expiries whose next plan started within N*24 hours.
-- The per-expiry maturity gate is kept: an expiry only enters the RN denominator once N
-- days have actually passed since it expired.
-- Cell encoding for the dashboard: "31.8%" when the whole window has matured, or
-- "73.3%*|<explanation>" when only part of it has. NULL renders as a dash.
WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::timestamp_ntz AS now_ist,
         DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))          AS today
),
per AS (
  SELECT 'D-1' lbl, 1 ord, today-1 f, today-1 t FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-2',2, today-2, today-2 FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'D-3',3, today-3, today-3 FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-1',4, DATEADD('day',-7,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)),  DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-2',5, DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-8,DATE_TRUNC('week',today))  FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'W-3',6, DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)), DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',today)) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-1',7, DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-2',8, DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM params
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M-3',9, DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',today)), DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',today))) FROM params
),
raw AS (
  SELECT router_nas_id                                       AS lng_nas_id,
    DATEADD(minute,330,otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz       AS plan_start_time,
    DATEADD(minute,330,otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz       AS plan_expiry_time,
    DATEADD(minute,330,created_on)::timestamp_ntz            AS recharge_time
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE auth_state = 1
    AND otp NOT IN ('FREE','PAY_ONLINE','CASH','ROAM')
    AND mobile <> '' AND mobile > '5999999999'
    AND store_group_id = 0 AND device_limit >= 10
    AND router_nas_id IS NOT NULL
    AND otp_expiry_time >= DATEADD(day,-220,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lng_nas_id, DATE(plan_expiry_time)
                                   ORDER BY recharge_time DESC) AS row_cnt
    FROM raw r
  ) WHERE row_cnt = 1
),
withlead AS (
  SELECT lng_nas_id, plan_expiry_time,
    LEAD(plan_start_time) OVER (PARTITION BY lng_nas_id ORDER BY plan_start_time) AS lead_raw
  FROM dedup
),
ev AS (
  SELECT DATE(plan_expiry_time) AS expiry_dt,
    DATEDIFF('hour', plan_expiry_time, (SELECT now_ist FROM params)) AS hrs_since_expiry,
    DATEDIFF('hour', plan_expiry_time,
             IFF(lead_raw < '2000-01-01'::timestamp_ntz, NULL, lead_raw)) AS hrs_to_renew
  FROM withlead
),
ns AS (SELECT n FROM VALUES (0),(1),(2),(3),(5),(7),(10),(15) AS t(n)),
stats AS (
  SELECT n.n, p.lbl, p.ord,
    COUNT(*)                                                                 AS total_expiries,
    COUNT_IF(e.hrs_since_expiry >= n.n*24)                                   AS matured,
    COUNT_IF(e.hrs_to_renew <= n.n*24 AND e.hrs_since_expiry >= n.n*24)      AS renewed
  FROM ev e
  JOIN per p ON e.expiry_dt BETWEEN p.f AND p.t
  CROSS JOIN ns n
  GROUP BY n.n, p.lbl, p.ord
),
cells AS (
  SELECT n, lbl, ord,
    CASE
      WHEN matured = 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN matured >= total_expiries THEN
        TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(100.0*renewed/matured,1),'FM9990.0')) || '%'
      ELSE
        TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(100.0*renewed/matured,1),'FM9990.0')) || '%*|Partial: based on '
        || TO_CHAR(matured) || ' of ' || TO_CHAR(total_expiries)
        || ' expiries in this window. The rest have not yet had ' || TO_CHAR(n)
        || ' day(s) since expiry, so this figure covers only the earlier part of the window.'
    END AS cell
  FROM stats
)
SELECT 'R' || n AS "Renewed by",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-1' THEN cell END) AS "D-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-2' THEN cell END) AS "D-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='D-3' THEN cell END) AS "D-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-1' THEN cell END) AS "W-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-2' THEN cell END) AS "W-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='W-3' THEN cell END) AS "W-3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-1' THEN cell END) AS "M-1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-2' THEN cell END) AS "M-2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN lbl='M-3' THEN cell END) AS "M-3"
FROM cells
GROUP BY n
ORDER BY n;
